verdict.rationale: Numeral documents an exemption-certificate object model (certificate_request, list/retrieve certificates with per-jurisdiction validity, expiration tracking) and lists 'Exemption certificate management' as a feature, but there is no documented API field for marking a customer/transaction exempt with a reason code, nor evidence that such a reason is carried through calculation, reporting, and the filed return end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit API parameter to mark a transaction/customer exempt with a reason, confirmation that exemption reason flows into tax calculation output, confirmation it appears in reporting and the filed return.
